metadata.title: Statistical inference primary sources
metadata.description: Interpretation principles, A/B test validity and variance reduction, sequential and anytime-valid inference, multiplicity procedures, eval error bars, prediction-powered inference, and conformal prediction variants.

sources.name: American Statistical Association statement on statistical significance and p-values
sources.description: ASA primary release with six interpretation principles, including distinction between p-values, effect magnitude, and hypothesis probabilities.

sources.name: Ramdas et al. — Game-theoretic statistics and safe anytime-valid inference
sources.description: Author paper describing e-processes, confidence sequences, optional stopping, and assumptions underlying anytime-valid inference.

sources.name: Angelopoulos and Bates — A Gentle Introduction to Conformal Prediction and Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification, v6
sources.description: Primary author tutorial; section 1 finite-sample calibration and marginal coverage, tie caveat, and section 3 conditional/group evaluation.

sources.name: Angelopoulos, Bates, Fannjiang, Jordan, Zrnic — Prediction-powered inference, Science 382(6671):669-674 (2023)
sources.description: Rectifier estimator combining a small gold-labelled set with many model predictions; arXiv 2301.09633.

sources.name: Angelopoulos, Duchi, Zrnic — PPI++: Efficient Prediction-Powered Inference
sources.description: Power-tuned lambda interpolating classical (0) and PPI (1); plug-in lambda (section 6); never asymptotically worse than classical.

sources.name: ppi-python package (import ppi_py)
sources.description: Reference implementation; ppi_mean_ci power-tunes lambda by default (clipped to [0,1]); default alpha=0.1.

sources.name: Evan Miller — Adding Error Bars to Evals: A Statistical Approach to Language Model Evaluations
sources.description: CLT and clustered SEs, paired differences, answer resampling, eval sample-size formula (n≈969 example); clustered SE up to 3.05x naive on real evals.

sources.name: Deng, Xu, Kohavi, Walker — Improving the sensitivity of online controlled experiments by utilizing pre-experiment data (CUPED), WSDM 2013, pp.123-132
sources.description: Control-variate variance reduction with pre-experiment covariates; variance factor 1-rho^2.

sources.name: Deng, Knoblich, Lu — Applying the Delta method in metric analytics: A practical guide with novel ideas
sources.description: Delta-method variance for ratio metrics when the analysis unit differs from the randomization unit.

sources.name: Fabijan et al. — Diagnosing Sample Ratio Mismatch in Online Controlled Experiments, KDD 2019, pp.2156-2164
sources.description: SRM taxonomy; chi-square check. Companion article (https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/articles/diagnosing-sample-ratio-mismatch-in-a-b-testing/) states p<0.0005 threshold and ~6% (Microsoft) / ~10% (LinkedIn subset) prevalence.

sources.name: Kohavi, Tang, Xu — Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments (Cambridge University Press, 2020)
sources.description: Practitioner reference for SRM and trust guardrails, novelty/primacy effects, and metric capping.

sources.name: Lan and DeMets — Discrete sequential boundaries for clinical trials, Biometrika 70(3):659-663 (1983)
sources.description: Alpha-spending functions for group-sequential monitoring with flexible look times.

sources.name: O'Brien and Fleming — A Multiple Testing Procedure for Clinical Trials, Biometrics 35(3):549 (1979)
sources.description: Conservative-early group-sequential boundaries.

sources.name: Johari, Pekelis, Walsh — Always Valid Inference: Continuous Monitoring of A/B Tests, Operations Research 70(3):1806-1821 (2022)
sources.description: mSPRT and always-valid p-values/CIs for continuously monitored A/B tests; arXiv 1512.04922.

sources.name: Howard, Ramdas, McAuliffe, Sekhon — Time-uniform, nonparametric, nonasymptotic confidence sequences, Ann. Statist. 49(2):1055-1080 (2021)
sources.description: Confidence sequences valid at arbitrary stopping times.

sources.name: Vovk and Wang — E-values: Calibration, combination and applications, Ann. Statist. 49 (2021)
sources.description: Combining e-values by product (independent) or averaging (arbitrary dependence).

sources.name: Wang and Ramdas — False discovery rate control with e-values, JRSS-B 84:822-852 (2022)
sources.description: e-BH procedure; FDR control under arbitrary dependence.

sources.name: Holm — A Simple Sequentially Rejective Multiple Test Procedure, Scand. J. Statist. 6(2):65-70 (1979)
sources.description: Step-down FWER control under arbitrary dependence; uniformly at least as powerful as Bonferroni.

sources.name: Benjamini and Hochberg — Controlling the False Discovery Rate, JRSS-B 57:289-300 (1995)
sources.description: Step-up FDR procedure.

sources.name: Benjamini and Yekutieli — The control of the false discovery rate in multiple testing under dependency, Ann. Statist. 29 (2001)
sources.description: BH valid under PRDS; c(m)=sum 1/i correction for arbitrary dependence.

sources.name: Romano, Patterson, Candès — Conformalized Quantile Regression
sources.description: Adaptive-width conformal intervals from quantile regression with marginal coverage.

sources.name: Tibshirani, Barber, Candès, Ramdas — Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
sources.description: Weighted conformal with test/train covariate likelihood ratio.

sources.name: Gibbs and Candès — Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
sources.description: Online alpha_t update; long-run miscoverage bound (Proposition 4.1).

sources.name: Angelopoulos, Bates, Fisch, Lei, Schuster — Conformal Risk Control
sources.description: E[loss] <= alpha for bounded monotone losses; lambda-hat via (n/(n+1))R_n + B/(n+1) <= alpha (Theorem 1).

sources.name: MAPIE package
sources.description: scikit-learn-compatible conformal prediction intervals and sets.
